_readme: Manufacturing company office, one floor, three colour options. Source deck exports are NOT committed (public repo).

Sources are the 1536 px renders embedded in the October deck, extracted as-is: the slide labels and the small key plan in each slide's corner are separate objects, so they are not in these files. The floor plan is the deck's layout page rendered at 3200 px and cropped to the drawing.

Client marks are everywhere in this deck: the name in large letters at reception, the lift lobby, two meeting rooms, the technical HOD cabin, a washroom and the stair; an orange six-petal logo on walls and panels in most rooms; the same logo in grey on cabinets and walls; and the logo repeated as frosted-glass manifestation on the glazed partitions. Option 02 was titled with the client's name; it is called grey and orange in the copy.

Reception, lift lobby, MD, plant head, small and visitor meeting, technical team and HOD, coffee counter, the gents and suite washrooms and the stair are excluded. Kept views are cropped clear of every mark, or (open workplace only) the distant logo on the green end panel is patched from the clean panel below it.

Not marks: the scattered single triangles on pedestals and corridor glass, sun and leaf line art, and process sketches on whiteboards and boards. Checked at full size; none carries a name or the six-petal logo.
